title: wmti Walkthrough
description: A wmti Walkthrough: an ordered, JSON tour of a codebase or change set that the wmti Neovim viewer steps through. NOTE: line_end >= line_start is a semantic rule the viewer enforces at load/resolve time; JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) cannot compare two sibling values, so it is documented here rather than expressed.

title.description: Shown in the selection list and the sidebar header.

steps.description: Ordered Steps. Array position is the Step order — there are no ids.

description.description: Optional. 1-2 sentences: scope and audience of the Walkthrough.

base_sha.description: Optional. The commit the Walkthrough was authored against. If set and HEAD differs in a git repo, the viewer shows a non-blocking "authored against older code" note.

file.description: Path relative to the project root, forward slashes. No leading '/' and no '..' segments.

line_start.description: 1-based first line of the Step's range.

line_end.description: 1-based last line of the Step's range. Must be >= line_start (viewer-enforced). Keep ranges focused (~10-50 lines).

why.description: Why this code matters / why it changed — intent, not a restatement of the code.

anchor.description: Optional but strongly recommended: the verbatim text of the line_start line. The viewer uses it to relocate the Step when code drifts. Omit it and the viewer falls back to raw line numbers.
